Klasse AddObstacle

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.graphics.AddObstacle
public class AddObstacle extends Object
Factory for creating and placing grid-aligned obstacle shapes on the course pane. All positions and sizes are specified in grid units (80 columns x 45 rows) and bound to the container's dimensions so they scale automatically.
